# Pull Request

## What kind of contribution is this?

<!-- Check one. See CONTRIBUTING.md for what each kind involves. -->

- [ ] **Live example** — adding a shipped artifact to `examples/`
- [ ] **Cohort entry** — adding a cohort to `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] **Template improvement** — refining a scaffold in `templates/`
- [ ] **New archetype proposal** (issue linked: #___)
- [ ] **New appendix / framework** for `PLAYBOOK.md`
- [ ] **Voice / clarity tweak** to existing prose
- [ ] **Typo / link fix**
- [ ] **Other** (describe below)

## What changed and why

<!-- 2–4 sentences. The "why" matters more than the "what" — the diff already
shows what changed. -->

## If you're adding an example or cohort entry

- **Archetype:** #___ ([name])
- **Link to the shipped artifact:** <!-- repo, op-ed, memo, event page, etc. -->
- **Who it reached, when:** <!-- optional but useful -->
- **One sentence on what worked and what didn't.**

## If you're proposing a new archetype

- **Issue linking the proposal:** #___
- **The v1 you saw shipped:** <!-- you can't propose an archetype without an artifact -->
- **Why it doesn't fit one of the existing sixteen.**

## Voice contract

<!-- See CONTRIBUTING.md "voice contract" section. -->

- [ ] If this touches the main menu, "The three questions," or the
      archetype file structures, I understand the maintainer will edit
      for voice before merging.
- [ ] If this adds a new appendix, case study, or archetype, I've
      signed it with my name and affiliation.

## Facilitator credit

- [ ] I'd like to be added to the "Facilitators using this playbook"
      list in `README.md`. (Optional.)

<!-- If yes, include: name, affiliation/city, course you facilitated, optional
bio link. -->
